stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: She finishes a painting of the harbor.
items.sentenceZh: 她完成了一幅港口画作。
items.scene: An adult artist at an easel adds the final brushstroke to one clearly visible painted harbor scene on canvas while the real harbor lies beyond her open studio window. Palette, brushes and the finished framed composition establish painting as both process and artwork.
items.altText: 画家在画布上的港口风景中补上最后一笔，窗外可见真实港湾。

items.sentenceEn: The scientist measures the health of the stream.
items.sentenceZh: 这位科学家测量溪流的健康状况。
items.scene: One adult environmental scientist kneels safely beside a stream, collecting a water sample in a clear vial and comparing it with a handheld color card containing no writing. A field notebook shows only simple drawn shapes.
items.altText: 环境科学家在溪边采集水样，并用无文字色卡进行比较。

items.sentenceEn: Her goggles and guard keep the work safe.
items.sentenceZh: 护目镜和防护罩让操作保持安全。
items.scene: An adult craftsperson uses a small bench grinder only after lowering its transparent guard and wearing fitted goggles, gloves and tied-back hair. The tool is stable, sparks remain contained and posture is controlled.
items.altText: 工匠戴好护目镜和手套，并放下透明防护罩后安全使用台式砂轮机。

items.sentenceEn: The neighbors reach an agreement about the shared garden.
items.sentenceZh: 邻居们就共用花园达成了协议。
items.scene: Exactly two adult neighbors compare two garden sketches made only of colored shapes, move the pieces into one combined plan and then shake hands warmly across the table. Matching smiles and the unified model show mutual agreement.
items.altText: 两位邻居把各自的花园方案合成一份共同布局后微笑握手。

items.sentenceEn: The capital is the center of national government.
items.sentenceZh: 首都是国家政府的中心。
items.scene: A fictional non-national capital city centers on a large civic assembly building, public ministries, central station and busy public square, with roads and rail lines visibly converging from smaller towns on the horizon. No flags, seals or real landmarks.
items.altText: 道路和铁路从远方城镇汇入中心城市的议会建筑、公共机构和车站。

items.sentenceEn: She opens her mouth for a gentle vocal warm-up.
items.sentenceZh: 她张开嘴进行轻柔的发声练习。
items.scene: A close but respectful illustrated view shows an adult singer opening her mouth naturally during a gentle vocal exercise. Lips, teeth and tongue are simply and accurately rendered without clinical detail, while one hand rests on her chest to feel breath.
items.altText: 歌者在发声练习中自然张开嘴，一只手轻放胸前感受呼吸。

items.sentenceEn: Neither the red door nor the blue door is open.
items.sentenceZh: 红门和蓝门都没有打开。
items.scene: Exactly two side-by-side doors, one red and one blue, are both visibly closed with their latches fully engaged. An adult visitor stands between them holding two unsuitable keys, looking from one closed door to the other.
items.altText: 一扇红门和一扇蓝门并排且都紧闭，访客站在中间查看钥匙。

items.sentenceEn: The flood victim receives dry clothes and a warm blanket.
items.sentenceZh: 洪灾受害者收到了干衣服和温暖的毛毯。
items.scene: At a calm community relief center after flooding, one adult displaced resident receives folded dry clothes and a warm blanket from a volunteer. Mud-stained luggage and a distant water-damaged street provide context without injury, distress spectacle or destroyed bodies.
items.altText: 洪灾后的安置点中，一名受灾居民从志愿者手中接过干衣服和毛毯。

items.sentenceEn: He reads the morning newspaper at the café.
items.sentenceZh: 他在咖啡馆阅读晨报。
items.scene: An adult café visitor holds one large folded paper newspaper with multiple columns, a masthead-shaped blank band and two simple editorial photographs. Pages are thin and broad, with all article content represented by unreadable decorative lines.
items.altText: 咖啡馆顾客展开一份宽大的纸质报纸，版面含栏目和图片但没有可读文字。

items.sentenceEn: The approaching storm is a threat to the harvest.
items.sentenceZh: 逼近的暴风雨对收成构成威胁。
items.scene: A dark shelf of storm clouds advances toward a ripe grain field while strong wind bends the outer stalks. Two adult farmers secure greenhouse panels and cover harvested baskets before the rain arrives, showing a credible environmental threat without disaster.
items.altText: 暴风云逼近成熟麦田，两名农民在降雨前固定温室并遮盖收获篮。

items.sentenceEn: Checking the lighthouse lamp is her responsibility.
items.sentenceZh: 检查灯塔灯具是她的责任。
items.scene: One adult lighthouse keeper methodically inspects the large lamp, cleans its lens and checks a plain tool kit before dusk. The repeated, careful duty inside the lantern room communicates responsibility for keeping the light ready.
items.altText: 灯塔管理员在黄昏前清洁透镜、检查灯具和工具，确保灯光正常。

items.sentenceEn: A warm smile appears when they meet again.
items.sentenceZh: 他们重逢时露出了温暖的笑容。
items.scene: Two adult friends meet at a train platform and greet each other with open arms. The foreground friend's warm smile is the unmistakable focal point, with gently raised cheeks, visible natural eyes and relaxed mouth.
items.altText: 两位朋友在站台重逢，其中一人露出自然温暖的笑容并张开双臂。

items.sentenceEn: The attorney explains the legal options to her client.
items.sentenceZh: 律师向客户解释法律选择。
items.scene: An adult attorney and adult client sit across a small office table. The attorney calmly points to three blank document folders and a simple balance-scale model while listening to the client. A courthouse is visible through the window, with no jurisdictional symbols.
items.altText: 律师在办公室向客户解释三份空白文件夹，窗外可见无标志法院建筑。

items.sentenceEn: The conductor studies the score before rehearsal.
items.sentenceZh: 指挥在排练前研究总谱。
items.scene: An adult conductor stands at an empty rehearsal podium studying a large bound orchestral score. Several staves of abstract musical notation span the open pages, while empty music stands and instruments wait in the hall.
items.altText: 指挥在空排练厅的指挥台上阅读一本展开的管弦乐总谱。

items.sentenceEn: She gives an account of her journey across the mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 她讲述了自己穿越群山的旅程。
items.scene: An adult traveler recounts her mountain journey to three friends, arranging a route map with no labels, a worn boot, a pressed alpine flower and three sequential blank-edged picture cards. Her gestures connect the objects into a coherent spoken account.
items.altText: 旅行者用无字地图、旧靴子、压花和连续图片向朋友讲述山地旅程。

items.sentenceEn: The moving fossil model is interesting to the visitors.
items.sentenceZh: 会动的化石模型让参观者觉得很有趣。
items.scene: At a natural history museum, a mechanical fossil model gently demonstrates how an ancient animal moved. Three adult visitors lean closer with bright attentive expressions and point out different joints, showing sustained interest rather than surprise alone.
items.altText: 博物馆的机械化石模型演示运动方式，三名参观者靠近观察并兴致勃勃地交流。

items.sentenceEn: The audience watches the actors in complete silence.
items.sentenceZh: 观众安静地观看演员表演。
items.scene: From a side angle in a small theater, two adult actors perform on a lit stage while several rows of seated adult audience members face them attentively. The shared direction of gaze and stage-seat separation make the audience role clear.
items.altText: 小剧场里两名演员在台上表演，几排观众面向舞台安静观看。

items.meaningZh: 富裕的；富饶的；浓厚的；贵重的
items.sentenceEn: The valley has rich soil for growing vegetables.
items.sentenceZh: 这片山谷拥有适合种菜的肥沃土壤。
items.scene: A cutaway view of a cultivated valley shows deep dark crumbly topsoil with roots, earthworms and organic matter supporting abundant healthy vegetables above. An adult farmer holds a handful of the fertile soil with satisfaction.
items.altText: 山谷菜地的剖面显示深厚黑土、根系和有机质，地上蔬菜茂盛。

items.sentenceEn: The family shares dinner after sunset.
items.sentenceZh: 这家人在日落后一起吃晚餐。
items.scene: Four family members of different ages sit around one dining table after sunset, serving a warm main dish, vegetables, bread and water. Evening light outside and relaxed conversation distinguish the shared dinner meal.
items.altText: 日落后的餐桌旁，四名家人一起享用热菜、蔬菜、面包和水。

items.sentenceEn: Residents vote for the new park design.
items.sentenceZh: 居民为新的公园设计方案投票。
items.scene: At a neutral community workshop, exactly two park models sit side by side, each paired with a transparent token box. Adult residents privately place one plain wooden token into the box beside their preferred design. No candidates, parties, flags or text.
items.altText: 社区居民在两个公园模型旁，把木制投票片投入自己偏好方案对应的透明箱。
